title: Hospitality Evening Series
description: A reference-led Ramadan and Eid campaign system that locks respectful evening hospitality and extends it across dining and gifting variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a respectful evening hospitality world built from lantern light, textiles, dates, table setting, and premium gifting surfaces; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while moving through hotel iftar, perfume hamper, and dessert presentation variations.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-evening-table-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-hotel-iftar-variation, 03-perfume-hamper-variation, 04-dessert-spread-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-evening-table-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
